title: Use the Gemini Code Assist agent mode
relevance_note: Defines how agent mode scopes persistent context (GEMINI.md) and how permissive auto-approval is gated by workspace trust.
reason_included: Official doc describing instruction layering/override for context files plus explicit safety gate for auto-allow actions.

claim_snippets.claim_text: The agent includes the information in your context file along with any prompts you send to it.
In IntelliJ, enabling Auto-approve changes makes agent mode automatically approve all requests and not ask permission before taking actions.
Yolo mode (auto-allow agent actions) can only be used in a trusted workspace; in a restricted workspace, the agent will prompt before taking actions regardless of the yolo setting.

Agent mode in VS Code can load `GEMINI.md` context from multiple scopes (global `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`, project parents up to project root/home, and subdirectories); more specific files override or supplement more general ones.
